title: The can's water level on the hotbar
about: Farm, day 4 at 09:00, a row of dry parsnips in the home plot and 2 water in the can (owner: "the watering can should show how much water it has in the hotbar"). Water the row and watch the can's cell drain to an empty ink track; refill at the pond (east, by the greenhouse site) and it fills again.
